description: Interface definition for the Cosmology Engine
purpose: Routes profile-neutral cosmology state and ontology bindings into the canonical ASH state contract

inputs.name: ash_baseline_contract
inputs.description: F2^9 state-space and fixed canonical codeword baseline used by downstream ASH pattern generation.

outputs.name: cosmic_state
outputs.description: The current profile-neutral cosmology state and its provenance-bearing ASH representation

outputs.name: profile_realm_definitions
outputs.description: Optional profile-supplied Realm identities and their explicit structural-coordinate bindings

outputs.name: ash_state
outputs.description: Complete F2^9 cosmic state vector supplied to the ASH Pattern Engine.

outputs.name: diagnostic_envelope
outputs.description: Cosmology baseline diagnostic record carried into downstream CosmicPatternSnapshot generation.

methods.name: initialize_cosmos
methods.description: Initialize the declared cosmology profile without authoring or replacing ASH mathematics

methods.name: get_profile_realm_definitions
methods.description: Return optional profile-level Realm identities and their declared coordinate bindings

methods.name: emit_ash_state_baseline
methods.description: Expose the complete F2^9 AshState and DiagnosticEnvelope consumed by the ASH Pattern Engine to build CosmicPatternSnapshot and GenerationPlan records.

invariants: YWE Core does not require a universal named-Realm vocabulary or profile cosmology narrative.
A profile-level Realm identity must declare its Structural Coordinate binding explicitly.
Profile realm definitions and presentation aliases do not rename ASH states or alter ASH mathematics.
Cosmology output must be representable as a complete F2^9 ASH state before pattern generation.
Downstream transitions use x' = x XOR c over the fixed 16 canonical codewords.
Cosmology does not materialize GenerationPlan outputs or author downstream adapter truth.
CosmicPatternSnapshot, DiagnosticEnvelope, and GenerationPlan remain downstream ASH provenance requirements.

ash_alignment_contract.math_basis: F2^9 full-state ASH vector with exactly 16 canonical codewords and x' = x XOR c transitions
ash_alignment_contract.truth_boundary: GenerationPlan may guide materialization; downstream engines and adapters must not author ASH truth or YWE domain truth.
ash_alignment_contract.engine_contract_rule: Cosmology is the upstream source of complete ASH state; materialization remains downstream of GenerationPlan.
